en.headline: HSBC names Hong Kong stablecoin RedCoin for PayMe users
en.dek: The bank said HSBC RedCoin would be offered through PayMe and its Hong Kong mobile app before the end of the year.
body: HSBC on Wednesday named its planned Hong Kong dollar stablecoin HSBC RedCoin, saying the token would be made available to more than 3.3 million users of its PayMe app for transfers, shopping and dining.

The bank said that when the coin is launched before the end of the year, it would be offered only through PayMe and HSBC’s Hong Kong mobile banking app. HSBC obtained a stablecoin issuer licence from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority in April and had earlier said it planned a retail roll-out in the second half of 2026.

A survey of more than 1,000 customers cited by the bank found that 74 per cent recognised at least one use case for stablecoins. The most commonly identified uses were digital asset trading and tokenised investments, followed by person-to-person transfers, cross-border remittances and merchant payments.

HSBC said it was optimistic about retail use of the coin. The bank has previously reminded the public that it has not yet issued any stablecoin and warned against fraudulent tokens that claim to be linked to HSBC.

zh.headline: 滙豐將港元穩定幣定名RedCoin 擬經PayMe推出
zh.dek: 滙豐表示，HSBC RedCoin將於今年年底前經PayMe及香港流動理財應用程式提供予用戶。
body: 滙豐星期三公布，計劃推出的港元穩定幣將命名為HSBC RedCoin，並擬向超過330萬名PayMe用戶提供轉帳、購物及餐飲等用途。
滙豐表示，穩定幣於年底前推出時，只會經PayMe及滙豐香港流動理財應用程式提供。金管局今年四月向滙豐發出穩定幣發行人牌照，滙豐早前表示擬於2026年下半年推出零售應用。
滙豐引述一項逾千名客戶的調查，指74%受訪者至少認識一種穩定幣用途。最多人提及的是數碼資產交易及代幣化投資，其次為個人轉帳、跨境匯款及商戶支付。
滙豐表示對零售應用感到樂觀。該行早前曾提醒公眾尚未發行任何穩定幣，並呼籲提防聲稱與滙豐有關的虛假代幣。
